unit.title: The Sikh Diaspora's Institutions and Impact

contentBlocks.text: Last week you learned the diaspora's basics. This week: a deeper look at its institutions and real-world impact!

Today, significant Sikh diaspora communities are concentrated in several regions worldwide, including the United Kingdom, Canada, the United States, and parts of East Africa and Southeast Asia — each with its own distinct community history and character, connecting directly to last week's content on early voluntary migration. Using last week's knowledge of why people migrate, explain why a diaspora community might develop its own distinct local character rather than being identical everywhere in the world.
You just reviewed where the diaspora lives today! Tomorrow we'll look at diaspora Gurdwaras' expanded civic role.

objectives: Name several regions with significant Sikh diaspora communities today
Explain why diaspora communities develop distinct local character rather than being identical worldwide
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review last week's diaspora-basics work briefly.
2. Introduce today's major diaspora regions.
3. Have the child explain why local character develops differently.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's Gurdwara-civic-role lesson.
differentiationTips: Struggling: use a simple analogy — the same family recipe often changes a little depending on what ingredients are available in a new place
Ready for more: ask the child what kinds of local factors (climate, existing communities, economic opportunities) might shape where a diaspora community settles and grows
Opens this week's diaspora-institutions thread, genuinely extending last week's introduction rather than repeating it
teacherGuide.answerKey: A diaspora community develops its own distinct local character because it grows within a specific place's own history, culture, economy, and existing population — the community adapts to and blends with its local context over time, so a community in one country naturally develops differently than one in another, even while sharing the same original roots.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses this course's global-diaspora thread, extending last week's foundational content into a deeper, more specific examination.
